statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model_name=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "Unknown Model"'); output_style=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.output_style.name // "default"'); current_dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd'); dir_name=$(basename "$current_dir");git_info=""; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || "detached"); git_status=""; if ! git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git_status="●"; else git_status="✓"; fi; untracked_count=$(git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | wc -l | xargs); if [ "$untracked_count" -gt 0 ]; then git_status="${git_status}+${untracked_count}"; fi; ahead_behind=""; upstream=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$upstream" ]; then ahead=$(git rev-list --count HEAD..@{u} 2>/dev/null || echo 0); behind=$(git rev-list --count @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then ahead_behind="↕${behind}↑${ahead}↓"; elif [ "$ahead" -gt 0 ]; then ahead_behind="↑${ahead}"; elif [ "$behind" -gt 0 ]; then ahead_behind="↓${behind}"; fi; fi; git_info="⎇ ${branch} ${git_status}${ahead_behind:+ $ahead_behind}"; fi; project_type=""; if [ -f "$current_dir/pubspec.yaml" ]; then if grep -q "flutter:" "$current_dir/pubspec.yaml" 2>/dev/null; then project_type="📱"; else project_type="🎯"; fi; fi; printf "\033[34m📁 %s\033[0m" "$dir_name"; printf "\033[2m │ "; if [ -n "$git_info" ]; then printf "\033[32m%s\033[0m" "$git_info"; printf "\033[2m │ "; fi; if [ -n "$project_type" ]; then printf "\033[35m%s Flutter\033[0m" "$project_type"; printf "\033[2m │ "; fi; printf "\033[33m🤖 %s\033[0m" "$model_name"; printf "\033[2m │ "; printf "\033[37m✨ %s\033[0m" "$output_style"; ctx_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // 0' | cut -d. -f1); if [ "$ctx_pct" -ge 80 ] 2>/dev/null; then ctx_color="\033[31m"; elif [ "$ctx_pct" -ge 50 ] 2>/dev/null; then ctx_color="\033[33m"; else ctx_color="\033[32m"; fi; printf "\033[2m │ "; printf "${ctx_color}🧠 %s%%\033[0m" "$ctx_pct"; printf "\033[0m"
